verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a remote-access product, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack shows TeamViewer offering a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of its core service. MSI mass deployment covers rolling out clients only, not hosting the server infrastructure. Community users seeking 'OSS and self-hosted' alternatives hint that it isn't available, but that is not direct evidence either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
